source: all input constructed in original main; no external file read
mask_meaning: bit x means topic covers unit customer x
catalogues: all distinct mask subsets of size1..min(3,2**n), explicitly enumerated in complete-built-input-catalogues.json
T: all combinations_with_replacement(catalogue,m) maximizing union cardinality; one canonical sorted order per multiset, no T permutations
realizations: only when m<=2 and p=1/2, enumerate all2**m replacement bit words with uniform1/2**m weights
matching: closed hypergeometric coefficient; no explicit m! permutation loop
anchor: each same-position index j where optimum[j]==profile[j], including empty theme; fixed theme protected, formula uses m-1 residual slots
